description: The ManageEngine ADAudit Plus login page is open in Microsoft Edge. Log in with username 'admin' and password 'Admin@2024'. Then navigate to the Admin area (click the '...' menu in the top navigation bar, then select 'Admin'). In the left sidebar, click 'Schedule Reports'. On the Schedule Reports page, click '+ Schedule New Reports' to create a new scheduled report with the following settings: Report Name 'Weekly Security Summary', Schedule Frequency 'Weekly' on Monday, Format 'PDF', and set the email recipient to 'security-team@company.local'. Save the scheduled report configuration.
